Treatments

Three specialties, one precise practice.

From a single chipped tooth to a full smile transformation — every treatment starts with a careful diagnosis and an honest conversation about your options.

01

Cosmetic Dentistry

Treatments focused on how your smile looks and feels, without compromising the health of your teeth.

  • Porcelain veneers
  • Professional teeth whitening
  • Smile design & digital mock-ups
  • Bonding & minor contouring
Ask about cosmetic dentistry
02

Endodontics

Root canal treatment aimed at saving the natural tooth, performed with precision instruments and a focus on comfort.

  • Root canal treatment (single & multi-visit)
  • Retreatment of previous root canals
  • Management of dental trauma
  • Pain diagnosis & emergency care
Ask about root canal treatment
03

Prosthetic & Implant Dentistry

Restoring missing or damaged teeth with implants, crowns, and bridges built for long-term function.

  • Dental implants (single tooth & full arch)
  • Crowns & bridges
  • Full & partial dentures
  • Implant-supported restorations
Ask about implants
